name: Gaddar
description: A young man leaves behind the woman he loves and his family to join the military. Upon his return, he faces unexpected events that transform him into a cruel man.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dağhan is the eldest of a family of three children... He lived a modest life with his family in a middle-class neighborhood. One day, after a violent argument with his father, Dağhan decides to join the military. About to return, he learns that his lover, Aydan, has participated in a beauty contest without his knowledge. Unable to control his anger, he breaks up with Aydan and joins the special operation. After some traumatic events, he returns to his hometown. But he can't find anything as he left it. His estranged girlfriend, Aydan, has disappeared. His family is dispersed... Things in the neighborhood are not the same, bad people are around, his old friends are involved in illegal activities. In a chaotic environment, a type called Manager also emerges. He offers Dağhan a job. Dağhan vehemently denies it. But while trying to protect his best friend Samet, he finds himself in the middle of trouble. He realizes that he must be ruthless to keep his loved ones away from this trouble.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Dağhan decides to do the job given by the Manager in order to protect Samet's family and comes to Yüksel's house, but he encounters someone he never expected, Aydan, his girlfriend from whom he broke up. While trying to get over the disappointment, spooky people raid the house, and Aydan and Dağhan find themselves in the middle of danger. While trying to escape this danger, they desperately try to repair their shattered love. Dağhan is busy gathering his dispersed family on the other side. He picks up Rüzgar, who got into trouble and was sent to the police station, and takes him home, trying to reconcile him with his father. Gürkan is almost sure that Dağhan has something to do with Samet's death and does not let go. While Dağhan was dealing with the new task given by the Director, he learns that Zafer, whose brother he killed, escaped from the hospital and goes after him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Dağhan returns home to find his father unconscious and his mother and sister at the mercy of Zafer's gun. While Dağhan tries to get rid of the trouble caused by Zafer, his family learns that Dağhan killed Zafer's brother during the events. Dağhan seeks help from his father, but Davut is torn between his son and his conscience. Although Aydan resists not betraying Dağhan, the anger between them never subsides. Aydan doesn't leave Şengül alone. Samet's brother knocks on Şengül's door, attempting to forcefully take Umut, whom he considers his brother's legacy, from Aydan and Şengül. This ambition puts Umut in danger of losing his life. Dağhan is worried because he can't find Yağmur. He starts investigating in the hope of getting some news. Meanwhile, Enver begins to chase Dağhan, the man who not only killed his partner but also managed to disappear skillfully.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Dağhan goes to kill Enver, who is the biggest risk for his family, he encounters a surprise he never expected. He learns that his sister Yağmur is with Enver. Yağmur gets sick because of the tension between Enver and Dağhan. Two enemies trying to kill each other are forced to team up and try to get her to the hospital. After the recent events he experienced, Dağhan's psychology deteriorates further. Moreover, there are things that both his mother and father are hiding from him. He becomes unable to trust anyone. Aydan also has a secret that she is hiding from Dağhan. Hoping that things will get better between them, she makes an offer to Dağhan. Ekber has now learned the secret that Enver persistently kept. His father's reaction is harsher than he expected. The showdown between father and son escalates. On the other hand, Şengül has now returned to her home, but the landlord wants to evict them because she cannot get the rent. Aydan does not like Dağhan spending time with Şengül.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Dağhan learns that the director sometimes sets targets independent of the Company, and these targets are always bad guys. This situation puts Dağhan at a new crossroads, as he begins to take pleasure in helping people in need and punishing the wicked. His relationship with the director, which he is forced to continue, takes on a new dimension. While Dağhan is pursuing his new target, Enver is trying to set a trap for him. He cannot directly attack Dağhan because of his promise to Yağmur. Therefore, he tries to prove that Dağhan is a hitman. On the other hand, defying his father, Enver hastily decides to marry Yağmur. Ekber Baltacı's strong reaction to this decision puts the two families against each other. The second part of Enver's plan to destroy Dağhan involves Aydan. He tries to persuade Aydan to join his side and get information about Dağhan from her. Aydan's mother, Oya, also supports her daughter's efforts to help Enver and puts psychological pressure on her.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Dağhan is cornered by the trap set by Enver. Gürkan has now learned that he is a hitman. But Dağhan chooses to fight instead of running away and hiding. It is time for the Director and Dağhan to clarify things. Dağhan starts looking for the murderer of the taxi driver who was killed in his neighborhood. While tracking the killer, he crosses paths with an old friend. Realizing that his son will not give up on Yağmur easily after his last actions, Akbar threatens Davut. On the other hand, the tension between Ekber and his son, who takes action to separate Enver from Yağmur, becomes even more dangerous. The solution Enver finds to get out of this situation drives Akbar crazy. Akbar, who said that he was not a monster until now, has now reached the point where he can do anything. No matter what, Aydan is still hopeful of reuniting with Dağhan. Oya thinks that this hope has ruined her daughter, so she tries various ways to save her from the love of Dağhan.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Dağhan and Enver are left helpless when Yağmur is kidnapped because Yağmur falls into the hands of a ruthless hitman. They start looking for Yağmur as soon as possible without disturbing the family. After the incident of the hitman hired by Ekber, the door to a showdown is opened between Ekber and Enver. Dağhan now thinks that Ekber is very dangerous, and he needs Müdür to eliminate him before he harms his family. Meanwhile, Dağhan receives a new target from Müdür. At a time when Dağhan feels very morally guilty, he meets someone new by chance. Will Davut's illness be an opportunity to reunite the family? As the ice between Davut and Fatma is about to melt, Fatma learns the secret that Davut is hiding. Gürkan continues to pursue Aydan after destroying the evidence. This tension between them also attracts Oya's attention. She tries to learn something to understand what kind of trouble her daughter got into. At the same time, her efforts to keep her daughter away from Dağhan continue.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Müdür learns about Dağhan's connection with Leyla and offers Dağhan to stay around him in order to use this to his advantage. Dağhan begins to feel remorse towards Leyla for killing her father and not being able to say this. After the trauma he experienced, Enver tries to recover with the support of Yağmur, and at the same time, he immediately starts his wedding preparations to show that he will not be defeated by his father. As Davut's anger at Enver continues, Enver looks for ways to redeem himself. Ekber suspects that Enver evaded the hitman, and begins to investigate who is behind it. While Enver thinks they will get married with a magnificent wedding, Ekber has another plan to prevent it. Despite all Oya's insistence, Aydan cannot stay away from Dağhan and finds herself in the middle of a new fight for him. The "cruel" rumor, which spreads everywhere, attracts Gürkan's attention. On the one hand, he follows Dağhan, on the other hand, he begins to question this rumor.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: When Dağhan kills the men in front of her eyes, Leyla begins to fear him and question who this man she trusts is. At the first opportunity she gets, she escapes from Dağhan's grasp. Dağhan tries to find Leyla with the support of Müdür. With Enver's arrest, events at home escalate. Far from being a disgrace to people, Davut gives up completely on marriage because he doubts his daughter's life and tries to persuade Yağmur to do the same. This issue causes the tension of betrayal between Fatima and Davut to intensify. Enver uses his last trump card against his father to avoid being imprisoned. The closeness established between Oya and Ekber in the wedding increases. When this closeness catches Enver's attention, he asks Aydan for help in finding his father's vulnerability. Dağhan and Enver join forces and start making plans to kill Ekber Baltacı. With the evidence he has, Gürkan goes after Leyla to find any trace of Dağhan. Through him, he begins to investigate his father's death.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Dağhan is forced to release Ekber in order to save Aydan and waits for news from him. Meanwhile, the Director and Kurt have wasted their last bullet and Ekber now accuses Kurt of betrayal. Ekber sends his men after Kurt and asks them to find him. Dağhan has to fight many obstacles to save Aydan.  Dağhan decides to make Enver pay for getting Aydan into trouble. Ekber learns that Enver has also ambushed him, and Enver confronts his father's men. Enver is sure that there is an informer among his men who has tipped off his father and starts looking for him. Ekber gets a reaction from Oya that he never expected. Rüzgâr starts to hang out with Enver very often, and Davut is disturbed by this situation. Yağmur thinks about talking to him because she cannot get over what happened to her and they cannot get rid of Ekber. While Gürkan is on the trail of the "gaddar", he learns about someone in trouble and continues to be around Dağhan in order to catch him red-handed.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: When Yağmur shoots at Akbar in a moment of anger, things get complicated. As a result of this mistake, friction arises between her and Enver. Dağhan is taken to the police station after Gürkan catches him in the act, and Ali files a complaint. Ekber gives Kurt one last chance to regain his trust, but this chance turns into a difficult test for Kurt. In order to deal a bigger blow to Dağhan and Enver, Ekber plans to put the notoriously ruthless Oleander Brothers against them. While Enver and Dağhan are looking for ways to unite and confront these brothers, Dağhan decides to solve it in a different way this time. However, this decision leads him to an irreversible mistake. When Dağhan is injured during the events, Aydan and Leyla mobilize for him. Ekber is impressed by Oya's confrontation and insists on meeting with her. However, Oya is determined to put a barrier on her relationship with Ekber after what happened to her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Kokut is determined to kill Dağhan in a ruthless pursuit of revenge for his brother Cezmi's death. Dağhan feels more helpless than ever in the face of death. While he resists, Müdür and Kurt race against time to save him from Kokut. When Kokut realizes that Enver is collaborating with Dağhan, he starts investigating his family to harm him as well. Leyla asks for Korkut's help to learn about her father's activities and what lies behind his death. Gürkan begins to question his values and sense of justice when a case that echoes in the neighborhood arises. Enver, upon realizing that Yağmur and her family are in danger from Korkut, gathers everyone to create a secure area. Enver's goal is to eliminate Korkut without harming anyone. To achieve this, he prepares a plan against the Zakkums with Müdür's help. However, his plans do not go as expected. This situation makes Korkut even more aggressive, demanding that the family sacrifice one of their own, forcing them to make a choice.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Davut's death leaves the family with a pain that is hard to overcome. Dağhan begins to blame himself and swears revenge, setting out after Korkut. Enver tries to solve the issue without bloodshed and approaches the Zakkums with a proposal. Korkut starts investigating his father's death to get closer to Leylâ. He continues to try to meet her again. When Dağhan learns about the connection between Leylâ and Korkut, he tries to distance her from Korkut, turning this into a confrontation between the two. Leylâ is forced to make a choice based on what she learns about her father's death. Dağhan bypasses the precautions taken by his family and joins Korkut. Korkut and Kalender disagree on their revenge plans against Dağhan. Kalender becomes increasingly worried about Dağhan. After the funeral, Korkut finds Dağhan and plays a game with him to make a choice, fueling Dağhan's revenge even more.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Korkut is even more out of control with Kalender's death, and while he is frantically looking for a place to attack, Dağhan has another plan for Korkut.  Korkut searches for a more precise solution to harm Dağhan and thinks of Aydan.  Aydan and Oya think they are safe in Ekber's house, but they are in greater danger. When Dağhan loses Korkut, he tries to get news from his family and Aydan to make sure of their safety, but he cannot reach Aydan. He gets help from Gürkan in this regard. Korkut manages to capture Dağhan with an ambush. His aim is to bring the two lovers together and make them suffer. The Director, Kurt, and Enver unite and try to save them, but Ekber blocks them. The family has not yet recovered from Davut's death and is shaken again by this news. Fatma asks Enver to help Dağhan to keep her son safe. Meanwhile, Korkut decides to hold Leylâ to account for her betrayal, but he is still afraid of hurting her.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: What Dağhan experiences because of Korkut and his brothers leaves a great impact on his world. Dağhan, who regrets making his family pay for being cruel, decides to listen to the advice his father gave him before he died and change his life. As Dağhan begins to take steps for his new life, a job arranged for him by the Director and a woman arriving at Mesut's door upset his balance again. He asks Dağhan for help, but when Dağhan rejects his offer of help, he is left alone. What happened to Mesut during the events makes Dağhan angry. He decides to defeat this trouble by doing one last job. However, Dağhan's decision disturbs Enver, and what will happen will reveal a secret that Enver tries to ignore. Dağhan is determined to fight without listening to anyone, but things are not as simple as he thinks. Dağhan finds himself in the middle of a large and dangerous organization. Every move he makes gradually makes him a target of the organization.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Learning that Ekber could not fulfill his duty, Arif Mubarak puts a hitman he knows from the company at Ekber's service. Dağhan and Kurt raid one of the points leading to the main house in order to get one step closer to Arif. Learning about this situation, Arif riots everyone, declares Dağhan and Kurt as devils and targets them. Aydan cooperates with Enver and looks for ways to anger Dağhan. After the last incident with Enver, Yağmur cannot digest what he saw and returns to the family home. Leyla accepts Korkut's offer of help and begins to fulfill what Korkut asks of her so that he does not return. Thinking that attacking Arif's house from the outside will not be enough, the Manager thinks that they can get a female informant inside and tries to persuade Leyla to do this. Even though Dağhan strongly objects, Leyla and Gürkan enter Arif's house. But a small mistake puts them in danger. While the repercussions of the Arif incident continue, Dağhan learns that Korkut is alive.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: While Dağhan is trying to make sure that Korkut is alive or not by working together with the Director, Korkut has teamed up with Ekber to put his plans into action. Korkut takes hostage the four people that Dağhan cares about and sets up various tricks for Dağhan to save them. While the Director, Dağhan, Kurt and Enver team up and try to save the hostages, they encounter various obstacles from Korkut. Since they are racing against time, they have to get support from other branches. Rüzgar's distressed and depressed state attracts everyone's attention, and his decision to leave causes a reaction from the family. He is worried about bringing Korkut Dağhan to his feet and putting an end to this. After what happened, Aydan panics when she sees Korkut in front of her. The idea of ​​Aydan being in danger infuriates Dağhan, and despite all precautions, he is determined to stand against Korkut alone.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After Korkut's death, Dağhan feels very tired and helpless, so he seeks solace with Leyla. Realizing that Leyla and Dağhan's communication continues, Aydan decides to stop resisting Oya's insistence and meet someone new. Rüzgar is relieved that his father's revenge has been taken. Thanks to this incident, the feeling of revenge hidden inside Rüzgâr is reborn. This adventure that Rüzgar goes on causes him great trouble. While the manager tries to strengthen the bond between him and Nilüfer, Nilüfer's hatred towards him continues. Ekber continues to try to find Nilüfer and hurt the Director. After what happened, the Director and Dağhan turn their arrows on Ekber and make a plan to kill him. Meanwhile, Ekber uses all his powers and gets support from the Company to put Enver and Dağhan on a difficult path.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: When Dağhan learns that his new target is Enver, he looks for a way to get out of this situation. Dağhan cooperates with the Manager and they try to reach the Company before the Company goes after them. After learning what happened, Enver's hatred for his father grows to an extent that he cannot stop. The Manager and Kurt find a way to reach an agreement with the Company and try to gain leverage by getting help from Leyla. Dağhan is absolutely against Leyla getting involved in such a dangerous event. While Leyla wants to help them, she falls into a dangerous game again. Meanwhile, Enver and Dağhan consider saying goodbye to everyone and getting lost for a while in order not to be seen, but when Yağmur's pains start, they have to go to the hospital. While escaping from the Company's men, they endanger both their own lives and Yağmur's life. Dağhan wants to talk to Aydan again about the baby issue, but Dağhan's new trouble confuses Aydan even more.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Dağhan does everything he can to save Mesut, but they end up feeling helpless as they wait for a resolution. Ekber's men come to take Nilüfer, leading to a confrontation between Müdür and the men. Nilüfer and Leylâ's safety is once again in jeopardy. Enver tries to console Dağhan amidst the chaos while the men from the company continue to set traps without missing any opportunity. The boss demands Dağhan's betrayal in exchange for saving his daughter from Ekber. While Enver and Dağhan continue to evade the hitmen to protect their loved ones, Yağmur starts showing signs of depression due to recent events and Enver's absence. Oya decides to leave with Aydan, thinking that being away from Dağhan will be good for her daughter. However, Aydan is hesitant, still holding onto a glimmer of hope. Finally, the boss and Dağhan come face to face. They both know that only one of them will come out of this alive.
